senses.gloss: (cmp. לוּז) to twist, twine; to weave. Part. pass. נוּז.
units: Kil. IX, 8 (expl. ש̇ע̇ט̇נ̇ז̇) דבר שהוא ש̇וע̇ ט̇ווי ונ̇וז̇ a substance (of wool and linen) which is hackled and fulled, or spun, or twined (R. S. woven); Sifré Deut. 232; Yeb. 5ᵇ; a. e.—
Nidd. 61ᵇ עד שיהא שוע טווי ונ׳ until it is fulled and spun and twisted (or woven).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:5:2">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>הוון אמרינן הא לָנוֹז מותר</he> we might have thought, but to twist (wool and linen) is permitted.
